mutations.name: L-SELECT
mutations._mechanism: Selecting the greatest listed basename violates the least-name contract.
mutations.find: min(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT
mutations.replace: max(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT

mutations.name: L-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: Ignoring an unreadable plan hides the error when no readable plan lists the target.

mutations.name: L-LISTED
mutations._mechanism: An unreadable sibling must not override a readable plan listing any canonical name.
mutations.replace: if listed and not any(m.status == "unreadable" for _, plans in per_name for m in plans):  # M:L-LISTED

mutations.name: L-ANY-NAME
mutations._mechanism: Considering only the first canonical name misses a later listed hard-link name.
mutations.find: per_name = [(name, _match_plans(root, name, records)) for name in names]
mutations.replace: per_name = [(name, _match_plans(root, name, records)) for name in names[:1]]

mutations.name: L-ABSENT
mutations._mechanism: An absent plan is not an unreadable plan and must yield not-listed.

mutations.name: LV-NONE
mutations._mechanism: A chain with no active records must print not-listed rather than an unreadable verdict.

mutations.name: LV-CHAIN-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: The listing CLI must report the unreadable state file instead of not-listed.

mutations.name: LV-RC
mutations._mechanism: An internal listing exception must return 2 while emitting only stderr.

mutations.name: CX-CALLEE
mutations._mechanism: Disable listing in the callee while keeping the real caller connection.
mutations.find: per_name = [(name, _match_plans(root, name, records)) for name in names]

mutations.name: CX-SELECT
mutations._mechanism: The caller must judge the least listed canonical basename.
mutations.find: min(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT
mutations.replace: max(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT

mutations.name: AG-CALLEE
mutations._mechanism: Disable listing in the callee while keeping the real caller connection.
mutations.find: per_name = [(name, _match_plans(root, name, records)) for name in names]

mutations.name: AG-SELECT
mutations._mechanism: The caller must judge the least listed canonical basename.
mutations.find: min(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT
mutations.replace: max(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT
